title: Nozzle Guardian: Pure-Python Driverless Printhead Preservation & Predictive Drying Architecture
description: Defensive prior art disclosure and software suite implementing channel-decoupled Mono/Color dormancy tracking, pure-Python RFC 8011 IPP + PWG-Raster + SNMPv1 telemetry, Laser/Thermal safety interlocks, lighting-adaptive EXIF nozzle scanner, and Antoine VPD hardware dongle firmware.
